errorPolicy.actionSpecific: each tools[].errors list is additional and preserves the current tool/application stable code
errorPolicy.usage: locally decidable syntax, flag, combination, empty, and bound errors use code usage and exit 2 before source IO

sourceSelection.placement: leaf-command-local; after the selected leaf command and before any -- terminator
sourceSelection.precedence: nonblank explicit flag wins; invalid explicit value never falls back
sourceSelection.environmentRule: fallback accepts a safe exact session id only, never an alias
resolution: safe exact session id to control socket
safe explicit alias to alias symlink to exact session id
sourceSelection.authority: local control-socket filesystem access authorizes acting through that session; receiving session derives membership and trust and ignores claimed caller identity or manifest
privacy: no source session id in action result

sessionList.ordering: safe primary alias then session id, locale-independent lexical order
sessionList.staleEntryBehavior: skip invalid or non-live socket entries; retain live session with membership unknown when bounded status query fails

empty.next: start and join a Pi session, then rerun pi-bebop session list

memberTarget.resolution: exact name first, otherwise unique role

tools.delivery: online normal Follow-up; direct when target idle, queued behind active work when busy; accepted never means reply, delivered work, or completion
tools.cancellation: before dispatch prevents delivery; while queued/transporting returns aborted and releases local wait; no acknowledgement means delivery outcome may be unknown and cancellation never rolls back a target that already accepted

tools.delivery: online Redirect; direct when target idle, otherwise enters before target next model step after current assistant tool calls; never aborts and accepted never means reply or completion
tools.cancellation: before dispatch prevents redirect; after target acceptance cannot retract steering; missing acknowledgement is outcome-unknown and never a rollback claim

tools.delivery: durably persists exactly one target Inbox item whether target is online or offline; hint is best-effort; persisted never means read, delivered, started, answered, or completed
tools.cancellation: before persistence prevents write; persistence is never rolled back; cancellation/disconnect after write but before acknowledgement is outcome-unknown and caller must inspect/reconcile rather than blindly duplicate

defaults.recipients: every other configured member in manifest order

tools.delivery: durably persists one independent non-interrupting Inbox copy for every other member; no endpoint probe, shared ownership, live delivery, reply, or completion
tools.cancellation: broadcast id and per-recipient ids are fixed before writes; completed writes remain; remaining recipients report aborted when acknowledgement is available; disconnect may be outcome-unknown; identical retry reuses ids and reports already-persisted without duplication

tools.delivery: target records pending recovery before best-effort abort and hands guidance ahead of older Follow-ups; direct when idle; never rolls back filesystem, shell, network, or completed effects
tools.cancellation: before target evidence prevents request; after evidence cannot delete recovery; disconnect/cancellation can lose acknowledgement but target recovery remains pending/reload-safe and no rollback is claimed

tools.delivery: read-only one-shot finite status query; configured target endpoint unreachability is successful offline/unavailable result with no stale Focus; never starts, steers, interrupts, or reads conversation
tools.cancellation: aborts finite probe/RPC and returns aborted; no target or session state is mutated

inputContract.focusText: required only for set; trimmed, single-line, NUL-free, maximum 256 UTF-8 bytes
inputContract.dashLeading: all flags precede --; text after -- is preserved verbatim

result.rules: set appends reported Focus; clear appends clear when reported; clear while unspecified is unchanged

tools.delivery: self-scoped context-free session entry only; no target, network action, task/progress verification, or conversation inference
tools.cancellation: before append prevents mutation; after append cannot roll back; disconnect before acknowledgement may be outcome-unknown but subsequent status is authoritative

inputContract.timeout: shared duration grammar; exact whole 1–600 seconds only; reject sub/non-whole seconds without rounding

tools.delivery: one-shot event-driven wait; no polling or target message; idle is mechanical and never proves message acknowledgement, reply, task completion, availability, or continued idleness
tools.cancellation: SIGINT/client abort closes source/target subscription and listeners exactly once, returns aborted exit 1, and never steers/interrupts target; semantic timeout wins simultaneous operation/transport expiry
